categories.main_business_segments: The company specializes in the research, development, production, and sales of experimental animal models, primarily focusing on genetically engineered mouse models. It offers a comprehensive one-stop service platform including model creation, frozen preservation, custom breeding, drug screening, and model sales. Key business lines include commercial mouse model sales, custom breeding, model customization, functional pharmacology services, and import-export agency services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced gene editing technologies such as CRISPR/Cas9, ES targeting, and transgenic techniques to create genetically engineered mouse models. It has proprietary platforms for gene editing, breeding, phenotype analysis, drug efficacy screening, and germ-free mouse and microbiota colonization. Production is conducted in SPF-grade barrier facilities with automated feeding and strict quality control, ensuring genetic stability and microbial safety.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers include research institutions, universities, hospitals, innovative pharmaceutical companies, and contract research organizations (CROs). The company serves both scientific research and industrial clients domestically and internationally, with over 2,700 domestic customers and more than 300 overseas customers across 20+ countries. Major end markets are life sciences research and new drug development.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China with production facilities in Nanjing, Changzhou, Foshan, Chengdu, Beijing, and Shanghai, covering all major domestic biopharmaceutical clusters. It has established overseas presence with subsidiaries or offices in the United States (San Diego), Europe (planned), South Korea, Japan, and Hong Kong, supporting global market expansion.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the biopharmaceutical supply chain, focusing on the development, production, and sales of experimental animal models and related services. It provides critical preclinical research tools and services to pharmaceutical developers and research institutions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include continuous innovation in animal model development, focusing on next-generation models such as wild-type mice with genetic diversity, germ-free and microbiota-colonized mice, humanized mice for drug screening, and antibody discovery platforms. The company invests heavily in R&D to expand its model library and develop integrated platforms like organoids and data platforms, while advancing internationalization and production capacity expansion.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of commercial mouse models, custom breeding services, model customization, functional pharmacology testing services, and agency import-export services. The company also earns licensing income from antibody molecules developed on its platforms and service fees from contract research.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the leading domestic players in the experimental animal model industry, recognized as a national high-tech enterprise and a member of the Asian Mouse Mutagenesis and Resource Association. It competes with established global companies like Charles River and Taconic Biosciences but holds a leading position in China with the largest gene-engineered mouse resource library and comprehensive nationwide production and sales network.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 686.8 million, a 10.39% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 109.8 million, reflecting a short-term profit pressure due to expansion and increased costs. The company maintains a strong asset base with total assets around RMB 2.57 billion and equity of RMB 2.13 billion, continuing steady growth and investment in R&D (13.73% of revenue).
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes innovation-driven development with a vast and diverse portfolio of genetically engineered mouse models, including proprietary 'Spot Mouse' KO/cKO models, humanized models, germ-free and microbiota-colonized mice, and wild-type mice with enhanced genetic diversity. It offers high-quality, reliable products with comprehensive traceability and quality control, supported by integrated one-stop services from model creation to pharmacological evaluation, enabling customers to accelerate biomedical research and drug development efficiently.
